blocked.name: The Masamune
blocked.why: Not reached. Researched: `Game.causeTriggerDoublers` reads `registry.get(...).static` only, so a static granted to the equipped creature (`grantsStatic`) isn't seen — `staticsOfSource` would; its look-back loop (a creature dying with the equipped one, itself included) reads the departed creature's printed statics and needs the granted ones as it last existed (the Equipment stays attached until the state-based check, as Wizard's Staff's `host` relies on); an emblem's triggers never reach the doublers (`permanentSource` is false for them), and the doubler needs a source clause "this creature or an emblem you own". The first strike and must-be-blocked while attacking are a conditional static on the Equipment.
